topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I found the flowers on my doorstep this morning, a brilliant bouquet of daffodils and lilies, so vibrant and full of life. There was no card, no note. I've been going over the past few days, trying to recall if I might have brushed someone the wrong way, or if there was something I failed to notice. I hope whoever sent them knows how much the gesture touched me. I wish I could thank them. I’ll have to keep an eye out, maybe there’s a way to find out who it was. I feel the need to make sure they know how much I appreciate it.
